title: 第185章 你敢吗第184章 闯阵
lines: 刹那间，狄娥尼索斯祭出了自己压箱底的至高幻惑神术。
只见一道无形的波纹以他为中心向四面八方扩散开来。那波纹所过之处，空气都仿佛变得粘稠而迷离。
此术以先前便已弥漫在林间的毒雾为引。一旦施展，其致幻之能甚至连高高在上的诸神都能蒙蔽一时。
凡入此阵者，脑海中关于愤怒、情欲、贪婪、嗜睡等种种唯有酩酊大醉时才会迸发的原始冲动，皆会被无限放大。
“不......不好！快闭气凝神，催动清明神术......！”
那些守卫中有人大声疾呼。
“晚了。”
占据了绝对先手的狄娥尼索斯冷笑一声。
只见林中原本妖异的紫雾，在这一瞬轰然转为如血般刺目的猩红，彻底将那群守卫吞没。
猩红的雾气如同有生命的活物，在林中翻涌缠绕，将一切都染上了血色。
“顶住！治愈法师，立刻施展驱散之印！快啊！”
面对这等闻所未闻的诡异神术，实力稍弱的守卫开始大批大批地瘫软倒地。他们的眼神变得涣散，嘴角流出涎水，如同喝醉了酒一般东倒西歪。
眼看狄娥尼索斯便要彻底掌控局势，变故陡生。
一道刺目的银芒裹挟着无上威压，自极远处的密林深处暴射而来。
那支银箭之上没有附加任何斑斓的法术流光，却在中途以一种近乎蛮横的姿态，生生将狄娥尼索斯的狂澜神术一撕为二。
咔嚓！
伴随着一声如琉璃碎裂般的清脆巨响，那支银箭在林间划出一道玄奥的轨迹，竟将狄娥尼索斯散布在虚空中的本源剧毒与漫天红雾，在弹指间吞噬得一干二净。
一时间，林间的空气重新恢复清新，月光洒落下来，照亮了那道缓缓从密林深处走来的身影。
“我当是谁吃了熊心豹子胆，敢在我的神山地界撒野——”
那声音清冷如冰泉，却又带着一种令人不寒而栗的威严：
“原来是个名不正言不顺的野种。”
狄娥尼索斯循着箭矢射来的方向望去，深深地低下了头。
那一箭不仅撕碎了他引以为傲的幻惑之术，更撕碎了他心中最后的一丝侥幸。出现在他面前的，是一道沐浴在银白月光下的身影。
阿尔忒弥斯从密林深处缓步走出，仿佛月光本身凝聚成了人形。
她身姿高挑而纤细，一袭银白色的猎装短裙紧紧包裹着她那曼妙而矫健的身段，将那盈盈一握的纤腰和修长笔直的双腿勾勒得淋漓尽致。
月光洒在她那裸露的肩头和锁骨上，泛起一层象牙般温润的光泽。
那头如瀑布般倾泻而下的银白色长发在夜风中轻轻飘动，每一缕发丝都仿佛被月光浸染过，流转着清冷而柔和的光辉。
她那张绝美而冷艳的面庞上，此刻笼罩着一层万年不化的寒霜。澄澈的眼眸中，此刻正翻涌着毫不掩饰的厌恶与杀意。
她赤足踏在铺满落叶的林地上，每一步都轻盈如雪，却带着一种令人窒息的压迫感。
content_en:
In an instant, Dionysus used his supreme magic of illusion at the bottom of the box.
I saw an invisible ripple spreading out in all directions with him as the center. Wherever the ripples passed, the air seemed to become thick and blurred.
This technique is guided by the poisonous mist that has filled the forest before. Once used, its hallucinogenic power can even deceive the gods from above for a while.
Anyone who enters this formation will have their minds filled with primitive impulses such as anger, lust, greed, lethargy, etc. that can only burst out when they are drunk, will be infinitely amplified.
"No...not good! Hold your breath and concentrate quickly, activate the Qingming Magic...!"
Someone among those guards shouted.
"It's late."
Dionysus, who had the absolute upper hand, sneered.
The originally eerie purple mist in the forest suddenly turned into a blood-like scarlet at that moment, completely engulfing the guards.
The scarlet mist was like a living creature, swirling and entwining in the forest, dyeing everything with blood.
"Uh...ahhh!"
"Hold it! Healing Mage, cast the dispelling seal immediately! Hurry!"
Faced with such unheard of strange magic, the weaker guards began to collapse to the ground in large numbers. Their eyes became distracted, saliva flowed from the corners of their mouths, and they staggered around as if they were drunk.
Seeing that Dionysus was about to take complete control of the situation, something unexpected happened.
Phew——
A dazzling silver light, wrapped with supreme pressure, shot out from the depths of the dense forest in the far distance.
The silver arrow did not have any colorful magic flow attached to it, but in the middle of the process, with an almost arrogant attitude, it tore Dionysus's Raging Magic into two.
Click!
Accompanied by a crisp and loud sound like glass shattering, the silver arrow drew a mysterious trajectory in the forest, swallowing up all the original poison and red mist spread by Dionysus in the void in the blink of an eye.
For a moment, the air in the forest became fresh again, and the moonlight fell down, illuminating the figure slowly walking from the depths of the dense forest.
"Who do I think has the heart of a bear and the courage of a leopard and dares to run wild on the boundary of my sacred mountain——"
The voice was as cold as ice springs, but it also carried a chilling majesty:
"It turns out he's a bastard with a shady reputation."
...
Dionysus looked in the direction of the arrow and lowered his head deeply.
That arrow not only tore apart the illusion technique that he was proud of, but also tore into pieces the last trace of luck in his heart. What appeared in front of him was a figure bathed in the silver moonlight.
Artemis walked slowly out of the depths of the forest, as if the moonlight itself had condensed into a human form.
She is tall and slender, wearing a silver-white hunting skirt that tightly wraps her graceful and strong figure, and vividly outlines her slender waist and slender straight legs.
The moonlight shone on her bare shoulders and collarbone, giving her a warm, ivory-like luster.
The long silver-white hair that poured down like a waterfall fluttered gently in the night wind, and every strand of hair seemed to have been soaked by the moonlight, flowing with a cold and soft brilliance.
Her beautiful and cold face was now covered with a layer of frost that would last forever. The clear eyes were filled with undisguised disgust and murderous intent at this moment.
She stepped barefoot on the forest floor covered with fallen leaves. Each step was as light as snow, but with a suffocating sense of oppression.
